info.title: Lucid SCIM API
info.description: The Lucid SCIM 2.0 API enables identity providers to automatically provision and deprovision users and groups in a Lucid account. Supports standard SCIM operations for user lifecycle management.

tags.name: Groups
tags.description: Endpoints that deal with org groups or teams (dependent on which bearer token is used).

tags.name: Schemas
tags.description: Endpoints that deal with lucid resource schemas.

tags.name: Service Provider Config

get.description: Get a specific user on the account.

401.description: Unauthorized. Occurs if bearer token is invalid.

404.description: Not Found. Occurs if the user was not found.

put.description: Modify an existing user. To deactivate a user, set the `active` field to `false`.

400.description: Bad Request. Occurs if request body syntax is incorrect.

400.description: Bad Request. Occurs if request body syntax is incorrect.

401.description: Unauthorized. Occurs if bearer token is invalid.

404.description: Not Found. Occurs if the user does not exist.

409.description: Conflict. Occurs if new username or email already exists on account.

delete.description:
> ❗️ This is a hard delete. We recommend deactivating users instead of deleting them. To deactivate a user, use PUT or PATCH and set the active field to false.

Delete a user from the account. Note that certain users cannot be deleted, such as account owners and default document owners.

204.description: No Content. User was successfully deleted.

400.description: Bad Request. Occurs if an unexpected error prevents user deletion.

401.description: Unauthorized. Occurs if bearer token is invalid.

404.description: Not Found. Occurs if the user does not exist.

409.description: Conflict. Occurs if the user cannot be deleted (e.g., account owner or default document owner).

get.description: Gets all users on an account.

parameters.name: startIndex
parameters.description: Index of the first user in the list to return (1 indexed).

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Quantity of users to return from this request.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description:
See SCIM spec and optimization details below:
* The only operator currently supported is eq
* Filtered requests will result in a maximum of 10,000 users
* While filtering should technically work on every attribute of a user, it is a very slow process for non-optimized attributes. We strongly recommend filtering only on the following optimized attributes whenever possible:
  * email / emails.value / workemail
  * username / displayname
  * externalid
  * urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:lucid:1.0:User.productLicenses.<name>

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of attribute names to include in the response. The attribute id is always returned. Cannot be used with excludedAttributes.

parameters.name: excludedAttributes
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of attribute names to exclude from the response. The attribute id is always returned and cannot be excluded. Cannot be used with attributes.

200.description: OK. Returns a JSON object containing a list of users. Deactivated users will not be included in the totalResults or the JSON payload of users returned.

400.description: Bad Request. Occurs if the filter parameter has invalid syntax or uses unsupported operators.

401.description: Unauthorized. Occurs if bearer token is invalid.

400.description: Bad Request. Occurs if request body syntax is incorrect.

401.description: Unauthorized. Occurs if bearer token is invalid.

409.description: Conflict. if username or email already exists on the account.

424.description: Failed Dependency. Occurs if add-on license requires base license to be active.

404.description: Not Found. Occurs if the group was not found.

put.description: Modify an existing org group or team.

200.description: OK. Returns the modified group or team.

404.description: Not Found. Occurs if the group was not found.

409.description: Conflict. Occurs if the group name already exists on the account. Org group and team namespaces are distinct, though the latter includes archived teams.

patch.description: Modify an existing org group or team.

schemas.description: URIs identifying the SCIM schemas that describe this resource's attributes.

Operations.description: Type of operation being performed (add, remove, or replace).

400.description: Bad Request. Occurs if the request body syntax is incorrect.

401.description: Unauthorized. Occurs if bearer token is invalid.

404.description: Not Found. Occurs if the group was not found.

409.description: Conflict. Occurs if the group name already exists on the account. Org group and team namespaces are distinct, though the latter includes archived teams.

delete.description: Delete an existing org group or archive an existing team.

204.description: No Content. Occurs if the delete was successful.

400.description: Bad Request. May occur if an org group still has members.

get.description: Gets all org groups or teams on an account. Supports pagination and filtering.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter groups/teams using SCIM filter syntax. Only single filter queries are supported. Currently supports filtering by displayName (case-sensitive exact match).

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Maximum number of groups/teams to return per page for pagination. Negative values are interpreted as 0.

parameters.name: startIndex
parameters.description: The 1-based index of the first result to return for pagination. Values less than 1 are interpreted as 1.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of attribute names to return in the response. The attribute id is always returned. Available attributes are schemas, displayName, members, and meta. Cannot be used with excludedAttributes.

parameters.name: excludedAttributes
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of attribute names to exclude from the response. The attribute id is always returned and cannot be excluded. Can exclude schemas, displayName, members, or meta. Cannot be used with attributes.

200.description: OK. Returns a list of org groups or teams.

401.description: Unauthorized. Occurs if bearer token is invalid.

post.description: Create a new org group or team, or restore a matching archived, closed team.

201.description: Created. Returns the created group or team.

400.description: Bad Request. Occurs if the group was not created.

401.description: Unauthorized. Occurs if the bearer token is invalid.

409.description: Conflict. Occurs if the group name already exists on the account.

UserBase.description: Core attributes shared by all user representations.

schemas.description: URIs identifying the SCIM schemas that describe this resource's attributes.

displayName.description: The name that is displayed and represents the user (usually their email).

active.description: Whether the user can authenticate to Lucid.

externalId.description: An identifier for the user as defined by the provisioning client.

phoneNumbers.description: A list of phone numbers for the user. Currently only "work" type phone numbers are supported.

roles.description: A list of administrative roles assigned to the user. Assigning a role to a user allows that user to perform administrative actions associated with that role.

id.description: Will be in the form "lucid-1234" with 1234 being the ID of the Lucid user.

User.description: A standard representation of a user.

password.description: Passwords must be at least 8 characters in length.

formatted.description: The users first and last name.

Name.description: An object representing a user's name in various formats.

type.description: A label indicating the attribute's function (e.g., 'work' or 'home').

primary.description: Used to determine the primary email of the emails given.

Email.description: An object representing a user's email.

type.description: The type of phone number (e.g., work, home, mobile). Only "work" type is currently supported.

PhoneNumber.description: An object representing a user's phone number.

EnterpriseUserExtension.description: Enterprise extension attributes for the user.

costCenter.description: The cost center associated with the user.

organization.description: The organization that the user belongs to.

division.description: The division that the user belongs to.

department.description: The department that the user belongs to.

value.description: The ID of the manager user. Will be in the form "lucid-1234" with 1234 being the ID of the Lucid user.

path.description: Path to the field you want to change.

value.description: The ID of the member. For org groups, this can be a user ID (e.g. "lucid-1234") or a subgroup ID (e.g. "lucid-group-5678"). For teams, only user IDs are supported.

$ref.description: The URI of the member. Points to /Users/{id} for user members, or for org groups, /Groups/{id} for subgroup members.

display.description: The display name of the member (the user's name, or for org group subgroups, the subgroup's name).

description.description: The description of the schema resource.

Attribute.description: An attribute definition for a SCIM schema resource. Complex attributes may contain subAttributes.

subAttributes.description: Defines nested attributes for complex attribute types.

SubAttribute.description: A leaf-level attribute definition. Like Attribute but without subAttributes, since sub-attributes cannot themselves be complex.

type.description: What the type of the attribute is.

multiValued.description: Indicates whether the attribute can have multiple values.

description.example: A way to identify the user

required.description: Whether or not the attribute is required.

caseExact.description: If the attribute is case sensitive.
